title.narrative: Hacia un futuro con igualdad, con mejores sistemas de protección social universal y de inclusión laboral - "Perú Social" - GIZ

description.narrative: Contract related to: Hacia un futuro con igualdad, con mejores sistemas de protección social universal y de inclusión laboral - "Perú Social" - GIZ - Peru is currently in crisis. In December 2022, President Castillo was confined and Vice President Boluarte swore to lead a technical, transitional government. The scenario led to nationwide protests and a national "state of emergency" was declared. New elections are to take place at the latest in April 2024. The protests reflect discontent with the political class, wide social inequalities, and the exclusion of a large part of the population from decision processes and access to social services.Peru counts with an updated National Policy for Development and Social Inclusion (PNDIS) and the ambitious development plan Vision 2050. But a national consensus on social protection, or a social pact, are yet to be built. The EU is a reference and privileged partner in this field. Based on relevant expertise, EU added value and potential impact, and its importance for sustainable development, the MIP 2021-2024 includes Human Development as priority area 2. It includes the sectors social protection and migration. The action consequently also promotes migrant regularization, inclusion of migrants into national social protection schemes and their labour market integration.The Overall Objective is to see Peru make progress towards a universal, inclusive Social Protection System (SPS), with equal opportunities for all, regardless of nationality.Specific objectives (Outcomes) are:-To design and enforce legal and policy frameworks for a) non-contributory and contributory social protection and b) employment policies with a right based, intercultural and gender focus,-To increase the coverage, enhance the adequacy and improve the quality of social protection programmes and schemes and active labour market services at territorial level, with a clear focus on gender equality and interculturality,-To improve social protection and social-economic integration measures for migrants and refugees.The 19 MEUR Action (14 MEUR EU and 4 MEUR DE) shall be implemented by IILA and GIZ. It is complementary to bilateral health sector and migration support, and the regional TEI Inclusive Societies.

It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.
